# Next.js — Kimox Studio conventions

Extracted from the App Router projects in the studio: `kimoxstudio.com`,
`alea-webapp`, `rachafit`, `patri-santana` and `kimox-fw/example-app`. Where
they agree it is a rule; where they diverge it is marked and left open.

`characters-vault/apps/web` is on the **Pages Router** with Next 13.3 and
styled-jsx. It is the one legacy app; nothing here describes it, and porting it is a
migration — see `kx-standards`.

## Layout

```
app/          routes only — pages, layouts, route handlers under app/api/
components/   PascalCase .tsx
lib/          shared logic
public/       static assets
```

No component, util or business logic file lives under `app/`. The path alias is
`@/*` from the repo root, in every project.

**Divergent:** `alea-webapp` splits `lib/server/`; `rachafit` splits
`lib/client/`; `patri-santana` splits nothing. Follow whatever the repo already
does rather than introducing the other shape.

## The server/client boundary

- **Root layouts are server components.** They export `metadata` and never
  carry `"use client"`.
- **Pages are `async` server components by default** — they await auth, session
  and data, then redirect or render.
- **`"use client"` appears only in a component that uses a React hook.**

That last one is the rule with teeth. `Button.tsx` and `Card.tsx` in `rachafit`
have no directive because they take props and return JSX. `ActivityPicker.tsx`
has one because it uses `useState`, `useEffect` and `useQuery`.

**Test:** if you are adding `"use client"`, name the hook that forces it. If
you cannot, the directive is wrong — and it pulls everything the component
imports into the client bundle with it.

Push the directive to the leaf. A page that needs one interactive control keeps
the page a server component and puts the directive on the control.

## Data fetching

Server components fetch directly. Anything the client refetches, caches or
invalidates goes through **TanStack Query** — both projects that fetch on the
client use it, with query keys collected in one module (`lib/client/queries.ts`
in `rachafit`).

Do not introduce a second client-side data layer. `useEffect` plus `fetch` plus
`useState` reimplements caching, deduplication and invalidation badly.

No project configures `revalidate` or opts out of caching in `next.config`;
defaults are what everything runs on today.

## Components

Props are a `type` declared at the top of the file, extending the DOM element's
attributes when the component wraps one:

```tsx
type CardProps = HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { tap?: boolean }

export default function Card({ tap, className = '', children, ...rest }: CardProps) {
```

Variants are string-literal unions on a prop, defaults come from destructuring,
and the rest spreads through. **No CSS-in-JS** anywhere in the studio — no
styled-components, no emotion.

## Metadata

Static pages export `const metadata`; anything per-route or per-locale uses
`generateMetadata()`. Pages that must not be indexed set it explicitly, as
`rachafit`'s sign-in page does with `noindex` and a null canonical.

## Loading and error states — a known gap

**No project has an `error.tsx` or a `loading.tsx`.** `rachafit` renders
`Skeleton`, `JournalSkeleton` and `Spinner` conditionally instead.

Recorded as fact, not endorsed: without `error.tsx` a throw in a server
component surfaces as the framework's default error page. Follow the existing
pattern in a repo, and if a phase would benefit from a route-level boundary,
propose it rather than adding one quietly.

## Divergences, stated

Every one of these is per-project. Read the repo before assuming.

| | rachafit | alea-webapp | patri-santana | kimoxstudio.com |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Auth | Clerk | Supabase | none | — |
| Database | Drizzle + Neon | Supabase | none | none |
| UI | own components | Radix | own | own |
| Forms | Zod | react-hook-form + Zod | none | Zod schemas |
| i18n | none | next-intl `[locale]` | none | none |
| `next.config` | large: redirects, PWA headers, `serverExternalPackages`, 15 MB action limit | small: next-intl, image patterns, security headers | default | — |

There is no studio-wide answer on auth, database or UI library. A plan that
touches one must say which the project uses.
